candidates.name: 方案1：北京-长春-兰州-开罗-卢克索-赫尔格达-北京
candidates.why: Best balance: slightly higher estimated price than the cheapest option, but saves several hours and gives a fuller Egypt itinerary with Cairo/Giza, Luxor and Red Sea.
traveler_a_segments: LHW-CAI via a China hub, preferably through-ticket with checked baggage
traveler_b_segments: CAI-LHW via the same or nearby China hub
risk_notes: Sep27 has a tight Changchun-to-Lanzhou-to-international-hub chain; avoid self-transfer with checked bags unless layover exceeds 5-6 hours.
Use a through-ticket for Lanzhou-Egypt if possible so baggage and misconnection handling stay protected.

candidates.name: 方案1：北京-长春-兰州-开罗-沙姆沙伊赫-北京
candidates.why: Strongest pure beach/diving choice, but adding Luxor history normally adds extra flight backtracking through Cairo.
risk_notes: If Luxor is mandatory, this variant becomes noticeably slower than Hurghada.
Sharm is better when the sea experience has more weight than total transfer time.

candidates.name: 方案2：北京-兰州-开罗-卢克索-赫尔格达-郑州-北京
candidates.why: Lowest estimated cash cost, but the Zhengzhou-before-Oct5 constraint forces an earlier Egypt exit and adds a less efficient return leg.
traveler_a_segments: CGO-BJS by flight or high-speed rail
risk_notes: Arriving Zhengzhou before Oct5 means leaving Egypt no later than Oct3 or very early Oct4 in most practical routings.
If CGO-BJS is domestic flight, airport time can erase much of the speed advantage versus high-speed rail.

candidates.name: 方案2：北京-兰州-开罗-沙姆沙伊赫-郑州-北京
candidates.why: Good Red Sea resort experience, but weaker for combined history-plus-beach optimization under the Oct5 Zhengzhou deadline.
risk_notes: Keeping both Luxor and Sharm in a 7-day Egypt window is possible but transfer-heavy.
Better only if beach quality is weighted above price/time.

candidates.name: 方案3：9/24晚北京-兰州，9/27早兰州-长春，9/29北京往返埃及：开罗-卢克索-赫尔格达
candidates.why: Best full-experience branch under the new plan: Beijing-Cairo round trip simplifies the international ticket, while Luxor-Hurghada gives the strongest history-plus-Red-Sea route.
traveler_b_segments: LHW-BJS-CAI around Sep29 if joining the Beijing-Cairo international flights
CAI-BJS-LHW on the return, preferably through-ticket with checked baggage
risk_notes: Adds a domestic triangle before the international trip, so Sep27-Sep29 buffer in Beijing is important.
The Beijing-Cairo round trip is usually easier to price and protect than Lanzhou-Cairo open-jaw routes.
This branch has more Egypt internal movement than Cairo-Sharm, but the history experience is much stronger.

candidates.name: 方案3：9/24晚北京-兰州，9/27早兰州-长春，9/29北京往返埃及：开罗-沙姆沙伊赫
candidates.why: Best pure price-time branch in the new plan: fewer Egypt internal transfers and a straightforward Beijing-Cairo round trip, but it gives up Luxor.
traveler_b_segments: LHW-BJS-CAI around Sep29 if joining the Beijing-Cairo international flights
CAI-BJS-LHW on the return, preferably through-ticket with checked baggage
risk_notes: This scores well on price/time because it removes Luxor and the Luxor-Hurghada land transfer.
Historical depth is lower: Cairo and Giza carry the history component, while Luxor is skipped.
Better if the trip is meant to feel more like Cairo highlights plus Red Sea vacation.
